exam_scheme.note: Chhattisgarh Pre Engineering Test (CG PET) is conducted by the Chhattisgarh Professional Examination Board (CG Vyapam / छत्तीसगढ़ व्यावसायिक परीक्षा मण्डल, रायपुर) for admissions into undergraduate degree engineering programs (B.Tech / B.E. in Civil, Mechanical, Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, Dairy Technology, Food Technology, Agriculture Engineering) across government, aided, and private engineering institutions in Chhattisgarh affiliated with Chhattisgarh Swami Vivekanand Technical University (CSVTU), Bhilai. The examination is administered offline across 33 district headquarters in a single shift using OMR response sheets. The test comprises 150 multiple-choice objective questions (50 Physics, 50 Chemistry, 50 Mathematics) carrying 150 marks for a duration of 180 minutes (3 hours). Each correct question awards +1 mark; there is no negative marking for incorrect or omitted responses. Post-examination counselling and seat allocation are conducted online by the Directorate of Technical Education (DTE), Chhattisgarh.

competition_benchmarks.note: Official candidate attendance and merit list metrics published by CG Vyapam. In the 2024 cycle, 12,068 candidates appeared in the Pre-PET entrance examination and were assigned state merit ranks on the official combined merit list. Over 11,000 engineering seats are offered across 30+ government and private engineering institutes affiliated with CSVTU Bhilai.
